name: Yumo
source:
She was the president of a club, and after graduation she joined an Internet company as a planner.
Her first impression is often that she is cold and taciturn, but as you get to know her, you will discover her gentle and helpful side. If you have a deeper relationship with her, you may discover more?
She is overly polite in her words, and it is no exaggeration to say that "thank you for your hard work" is her catchphrase.

[Translated from [url=https://www.cngal.org/entries/index/3897]CnGal[/url]]
